再次触发才停止输出: Keep output on until triggered again
按所选触发方式启动输出，松开手柄后仍保持；再次触发时停止。停止映射、断连或开始录: Start output with the selected trigger and keep it on after releasing the controller. Trigger again to stop. Stopping mapping, disconnecting, or recording an input clears the latch.
支持键盘、鼠标按键和虚拟手柄按键。滚轮需开启连续滚动才会持续滚动；组合键优先触发: Works with keyboard keys, mouse buttons, and virtual controller buttons. Wheel output continues only with repeat scrolling enabled. A winning chord cancels the latch of its consumed single input.
可按住启用，也可按一下切换开关。未覆盖的设置与动作继承基础层；多个层按列表顺序叠: Hold to enable or press to toggle. Settings and actions without overrides are inherited from the base layer. Active layers stack in list order; later layers take priority.
关闭所有操作层；仍按住的启用输入需先松开再按。此按键原有的动作映射仍会执行。: Close all layers. Held activation inputs must be released before reactivating. Other actions bound to this input still run.
按住启用，松开恢复: Hold to enable, release to restore
按一下开启，再按一下关闭: Press to enable, press again to disable
停止映射、断连或开始录入会清除层开关。重连时已按住的输入需先松开再按。: Stopping mapping, disconnecting, or recording an input clears layer toggles. Inputs held during reconnection must be released before reactivating.
下列覆盖在对应层同时启用时生效。同一输入的短按、长按、双击会一起被覆盖。: These overrides apply when the corresponding layers are active together. Tap, long press, and double press on the same input are all replaced.
会被高优先级层覆盖: Replaced by a higher priority layer
此层没有相同输入的动作覆盖。: This layer has no action overrides on matching inputs.
此层会整体替换虚拟手柄映射列表。: This layer replaces the entire virtual controller mapping list.
选择要编辑的层；游戏中由该层的启用方式控制。: Select a layer to edit. Its activation setting controls when it applies in game.
配置层与当前配置一起保存。选择编辑层不会立即启用它，游戏中由按住或切换输入控制。: Layers are saved with the current profile. Selecting a layer for editing does not activate it; hold or toggle its input in game.
此配置尚未输出，或正在录入／导航；恢复映射后可查看判定状态。: This profile is not emitting, or input recording/navigation is active. Resume mapping to see its decisions.
显示当前已保存配置的按键判定；短促状态可能在两次界面刷新之间完成。: Shows button decisions for the saved running profile. Brief states may finish between UI updates.
当前没有触发中的按键动作。: No button actions are currently triggered.
每个游戏配置最多支持 8 个配置层: A game profile supports up to 8 layers
每次识别成功切换输出状态；松开手柄不会停止输出。: Each recognized trigger toggles the output state. Releasing the controller does not stop output.
每次开启时滚动 1 格；关闭时不滚动。: Scroll one step when toggled on; toggling off does not scroll.
